page.layout: One printed page (right of the gutter) with running text in one column; a heading centred above the text; below the text a centred heading "E 2 ARITH." and faint mirrored text from the other side (show-through); at the left edge a strip of text from the facing page, which is a neighbouring page edge and not transcribed.

main_text.head: Diuisionis exempla.
main_text.p: Diuidantur 4 per 7/9. Hic datis integra proportio—nalia inuenies: reductis namque 4 integris in nonas, partes erunt 3/9 6/9 & 7/9, unde integra 3 6 & 7 datis proportionalia esse uideo, atque ea inter se diuisa, quotum exhibent 5 1/7.

Item 1/2 diuidatur per 3, reductis 3 ad 6/2, inuenio 1 & 6 integra datis proportionalia, quae inter se diuisa quotum exhibent 1/6. Item, diuide 8 2/3 per 4 3/5: hic diuersi generis terminos per mistorum reductionem ad 2 6/3 & 2 3/5 reduces, tumāq; reductas cognomines facies, scilicet 1 3 0/1 5 6 9/1 5: deniq; eandem ad integra ipsis proportionalia, 1 3 0 & 6 9, reduces, quibus inter se diuisis, quotus quaesitus erit 1 6 1/6 9.
main_text.head: FINIS PARTIS PRIMAE.

page.notes: Faint show-through text from the reverse side is present throughout and was not transcribed. Several fractions and the lower heading are set in a smaller or unclear face; readings of the fractional numerators and denominators are approximate. The lower part of the page (below "E 2 ARITH.") is largely illegible due to faint printing and show-through.
